sources.title: В. Л. Лихачев. Обмоточные данные электродвигателей А2/АО2 8-9-го габаритов

notes: Closes two ordinary single-speed AO2 identity/rating gaps using row-safe values only.
AO2-82-8 is read as 30 kW / 725 rpm / 104/60.2 A in the frame-8 block.

AO2-91-6 is read as 55 kW / 985 rpm / 169/98 A; the same block clearly gives 458/334 mm, L=240 mm, Z1=72, pitch 1-11 and two-layer stator construction, but detailed Pe1/m1/a1/w1/conductor mapping remains interleaved and is deferred.
